name: Progressive
notes: Researched from public progressive.com pages only (no sign-in). Progressive publishes very little billing how-to content: the manage-policy page says the online account's billing and payments section shows the policy period, upcoming payments and billing activity, manages automatic payments and shows billing statements; it also offers 'Make a quick payment now' without logging in (review 2026-10-09: the public quick-pay form asks for policy number or email address, mailing ZIP code and date of birth, and says property policyholders are not accepted; modelled as account number + ZIP + date of birth). General customer service is 24/7 at 1-888-671-4405 (contact-us page); 1-855-347-3939 appears in the site footer. The public log-in form shows User ID and Password on one screen. The discounts page lists pay-in-full, automatic-payment (not combinable with pay-in-full) and paperless discounts. Installment and EFT fees, paid-in-full discounts and cancellation rules vary by state and are not published on progressive.com, so none are modelled; cancellation keeps the family default. MFA is not documented publicly. Review 2026-10-10: guest form set to exactly policy number + ZIP + date of birth (guestLookupExact), dropping the family's last-name field. Audit 2026-10-10 (insurance fixer): date of birth removed from the modelled guest lookup because no task gives the agent the persona's date of birth (bill notice and instruction carry account number, ZIP and name only), which made guest-pay unsolvable; restore "dob" once the bill notice or instruction supplies it (cross-owner request filed). Integrated 2026-10-10 (agent-solvability pass): the date of birth is back in the guest lookup (accountNumber + zip + dob); task instructions now state the persona's date of birth (tasks.mjs personaFacts).

sources.title: Make a quick payment (Provide Account Information)

help.title: Pay your Progressive bill
paragraphs: Log in to your account and open Billing & payments to see your policy period, upcoming payments and billing activity, and to make a payment.
To make a quick payment without logging in, enter your policy number (or email address), mailing ZIP code and date of birth. Property policies cannot use the quick payment option.
General customer service is open 24/7 at 1-888-671-4405.

help.title: Manage automatic payments
paragraphs: Automatic payments are managed in the Billing & payments section of your online account or in the app. There you can turn them on, change them or review upcoming payments.
Billing statements are also available in the same section.

help.title: What you can do online
paragraphs: With an online account you can review your policy and bill, update coverages, drivers and vehicles, manage automatic payments, check discounts and rewards, and download or send your insurance ID card.
If you get stuck, Progressive's phone support is open around the clock.

help.title: Contact Progressive
paragraphs: General customer service is available 24/7 at 1-888-671-4405, for billing questions, policy changes and claims. Progressive also lists 1-855-347-3939 across its site.
Logging in is the quickest way to reach billing and payment information, ID cards and proof of insurance.

help.title: Discounts tied to how you pay
paragraphs: Paying the whole policy up front can earn a pay-in-full discount.
If paying in full does not suit you, setting up automatic payments from a checking account, credit card or debit card can earn a discount instead; the two cannot be combined.
Choosing to get your documents by email can earn a paperless discount, and signing documents online can earn another. Savings vary.

extra.intent: Find the 24/7 phone number Progressive lists for customer service. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
